world_frame: UE world, left-handed, X fwd / Y right / Z up, cm
camera_frame: UE camera, X forward / Y right / Z up
depth: depth_planar_cm.f32, float32 HxW, planar depth along X (cm), NaN = invalid
world_xyz: world_xyz_cm.f64, float64 HxWx3, UE world position (cm), NaN = invalid
layout: row-major, row 0 = top of image, little-endian
